short: Congruence number for compact unitary groups

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Z.J.NumberU3U_s
lean.plain: Congruence number for compact unitary groups
lean.note: One nonzero integer is chosen before the coefficient prime $\ell$. At each $\ell\ne 2,p$, the sum of valuations of the nonzero differences between the admissible representations’ traces and the Eisenstein trace is at most the valuation of that integer, so the sum weighted by $\log\ell$ is at most its logarithmic size.
